name: 균열석
subject: One chunky irregular rounded violet stone, slightly taller than wide and tilted a little. A prominent single jagged fracture splits the front face, with just one short branch. Show the crack as dark plum/charcoal with a sparse pale lilac inner edge, without separate floating fragments. Mostly opaque solid matte stone, large light purple main plane and one dark mauve side/shadow plane. It must look like a cracked physical rock, not a cut gemstone, not a lightning rune. Keep silhouette plump with 5-7 broad corners, not tiny facets.

Main band remains intact and substantial. The broken shape must be immediately clear at 32x32. Warm pale yellow gold main plane, muted orange side plane, a little dusty rose deepest shadow inside. NO gemstone, no glowing particles, no scattered fragments, no elaborate engraving. Broad soft curves in the lower band and clean angular breaks in the damaged tooth; readable royal crown rather than a gear or bowl.

Slight diagonal stance, cloth and pole form a balanced substantial icon. One broad dusty burgundy shadow fold shows the billowing cloth; muted tan pole with rose-brown shaded side and a small rounded golden finial. On the cloth one large simple GOLD chevron/triangular victory mark, no text and no many tiny symbols. Avoid long thin shafts, skinny ribbons or wispy fabric. The flag should read as cloth on a pole, not a shield or wall plaque. Keep material planes large and simple.
